info.title: Switch Frame Tap
info.author: TomasUribe
info.description: Stream gameplay and audio to a PC without a capture card.
info.details:
Switch Frame Tap is a sysmodule for streaming gameplay and audio to a PC over USB or the network. It uses the H.264 encoder and supports up to 1080p60fps where available.

It supports native-resolution screenshots, recording through the PC viewer, network streaming, and USB webcam mode.

A reboot is required after installation or updating so the sysmodule can restart.

changelog:
v0.7.17

**v0.7.17: more games and homebrew, a calmer network connection, and an always-on-top viewer**

- **Fast RMX and other early games stream (#41).** Games built before firmware 3.0.0 send their frames to the screen in an older way, which Switch Frame Tap didn't watch, so it showed "the game is not on screen". Both ways work now.
- **16-bit homebrew pictures (#42).** Apps that draw in 16-bit colour, like DBI, showed a garbled picture. They stream right now.
- **Screen off while streaming:** no more flicker when a game pauses for a moment (Final Fantasy Resonance's battle transitions, #20). The console's screen comes back after 2.5 s without a new frame.
- **PC viewer (by bshurikan, #23):** a pin button keeps the window on top of others. Over the network, the viewer reconnects by itself after the Switch restarts or changes network (Wi-Fi to Ethernet), and if another viewer already has the Switch, it waits calmly instead of retrying over and over.
- **Network viewers now say why there's no picture** (no game running, paused for the eShop or the keyboard, and so on), as USB viewers already did.

**Linux, new from this release:** besides the tarball, an **AppImage** (`switch-frame-tap-0.7.17-linux-x86_64.AppImage`: make it executable and double-click it) and a **Flatpak bundle** (`flatpak install --user switch-frame-tap-0.7.17-linux.flatpak`; its runtime comes from Flathub). For USB they need the USB rule once - the README has the one-line command.

**Updating:** open the Switch app's **Updates** page (or unzip `switch-frame-tap-0.7.17-switch.zip` over the SD card root) and restart the console. Settings are kept. The PC viewers and the Android app offer the update when they open.

---
<sub>Switch Frame Tap is free and open source. If you would like to support it: [buymeacoffee.com/papux200](https://buymeacoffee.com/papux200)</sub>
